## Added

- Start UsageDeck with Windows and keep it hidden in the notification area until you open it. Find this option under **Settings → General → Background activity**.
- Pause notifications from the tray or **Settings → Notifications** for 30 minutes, 1 hour, 2 hours, 4 hours, or until the following morning. Usage monitoring continues while notifications are paused.

## Improvements

- Automatic refresh now checks the provider you are viewing. Select **All providers** to refresh every enabled provider.
- Refresh requests now wait their turn instead of being ignored. Provider updates also recover more reliably when a command-line tool stops responding.
- Unreadable saved settings no longer stop UsageDeck. The defaults are restored, the problem is explained, and a copy of the old settings is kept when possible.
- Sign-in problems can now trigger an alert after the first failed refresh. UsageDeck alerts you again when the provider reconnects, while turning off provider status stops further status alerts.

## Fixes

- Codex usage works again with Codex CLI 0.149.0.
- Switching from GitHub Copilot to Codex no longer closes UsageDeck.
- After starting with Windows, the tray icon and its menu respond immediately and a single click opens UsageDeck.
- The Rate limits section no longer leaves a large empty gap when there are no warnings to show.
- Update messages in the footer no longer push the provider status control out of view.
